### GameSquare's Hatchet Publishes Q3 2026 Live Streaming Trends Report


11/05/2026


Q3 2026 viewership, including new TikTok Live data, hit 29.5B hours watched


**FRISCO, TX /[ACCESS Newswire](https://www.accessnewswire.com/) / November 5, 2026 /** Hatchet, the leading provider of data analytics for the live streaming and creator marketing ecosystem and wholly-owned subsidiary of GameSquare Holdings (NASDAQ:GAME), ("GameSquare", or the "Company"), has released its Q3 2026 Live Streaming Trends Report. The report reveals key insights into the evolution of the global live streaming market across gaming, esports, and entertainment.


Access to the report is available at:[https://hatchet.gg/resources/guides/q3-2026-live-streaming-trends-report/](https://pr.report/t6j2)


**Capturing The Full Scope of Live Streaming with YouTube Non-Gaming & TikTok Live**


Hatchet's latest report now incorporates all live-streaming data in its total figures, including that of YouTube Non-gaming. Historically, this figure had been excluded to spotlight gaming-only content. But with the increasing diversification of content strands driving viewership on live-streaming, presenting data and context from every platform has become essential to reflecting the appeal of the medium.


"Hatchet's Q3 2026 report reinforces the scale, resilience, and continued evolution of the global live streaming ecosystem," said Justin Kenna, CEO of GameSquare. "29.5B hours watched is a milestone figure driven by a broad array of viewer interests, from entertainment to news to sports."


Kenna continued, "What's particularly compelling is the underlying stability and diversification of the market. Breakout events, new game releases, and always-on creator formats continue to drive incremental engagement. Hatchet is uniquely positioned to provide actionable insights that help brands, publishers, and creators better connect with global audiences and maximize return on investment."


**Key Insights from Hatchet's Q3 2026 Report:**


- Live-streaming hit 29.5B hours watched in Q3 2026 with non-gaming content on YouTube and TikTok Live pushing viewership to new heights.


- The impending launch of GTA VI shaped Q3 trends, with a +22.9% boost in GTA V viewership, a lack of big new releases, and a rise in the demand for GTA roleplay content.


- Streamer-led events rivalled esports this quarter, with Ibai's La Velada del Año VI (7.9M) and Kai Cenat's Streamer University (1.3M) putting up peaks on par with LoL and ML:BB's biggest tournaments.


- Creators saw a massive shake up with long-reigning names like TheBurntPeanut and Sakura Miku ceding ground or losing positions entirely to fresh faces like DeentheGreat (139%) and Zullyy (201%).


For more information on Hatchet and insights into the esports and streaming markets, please visit their website at[www.hatchet.gg](https://pr.report/t6j3)


**About GameSquare Holdings, Inc.**


GameSquare (NASDAQ: GAME) is a cutting-edge media, entertainment, and technology company transforming how brands and publishers connect with Gen Z, Gen Alpha, and Millennial audiences. With a platform that spans award-winning creative services, advanced analytics, and FaZe Esports, one of the most iconic gaming organizations, we operate one of the largest gaming media networks in North America. As a digital-native business, GameSquare provides brands with unparalleled access to world-class creators and talent, delivering authentic connections across gaming, esports, and youth culture. Complementing our operating strategy, GameSquare has developed an innovative treasury management program designed to generate yield and enhance capital efficiency, reinforcing our commitment to building a dynamic, high-performing media company at the intersection of culture, technology, and next-generation financial innovation.


To learn more, visit[www.gamesquare.com](https://pr.report/t6j4) .


**About Hatchet**


Hatchet delivers real-time, actionable insights into the creator ecosystem across over 30 platforms and with over a decade of data. From performance benchmarking to campaign ROI and creator intelligence, Hatchet empowers game publishers, brands, agencies, and tournament organizers with the industry's most granular data and reporting tools.


For more information visit[hatchet.gg](https://pr.report/t6j5)
